docs/requirements.md.text:
# Account Management Requirements

FR-01 - Invite Team Member
An account owner can invite a user by email. The invitation expires after 7 days.

FR-02 - Accept Invitation
An invited user who accepts a valid invitation joins the account with the Member role.
An expired invitation cannot be accepted and the page shows the message "Invitation expired".

BR-01 - Seat Limit
An account cannot have more active members than the seat limit of its plan. An invitation that would exceed the limit is rejected with the message "No seats available".

BR-02 - Role Permissions
Only the Owner can invite members. Only the Owner can remove members.

UC-01 - Onboard a Teammate
Main flow: the owner invites a teammate, the teammate accepts the invitation and the teammate appears in the member list with the Member role.

invariants: active members never exceed the plan seat limit

requirements.source_statement: An account owner can invite a user by email; the invitation expires after 7 days.
An invited user who accepts a valid invitation joins with the Member role; an expired invitation cannot be accepted.
Active members never exceed the plan seat limit.
Only the Owner can invite or remove members.
Owner invites a teammate who accepts and appears in the member list.

claims.text: The owner invites a user by email and a pending invitation is created.
An invitation expires 7 days after it was sent.
Accepting a valid invitation adds the user to the account with the Member role.
An expired invitation cannot be accepted and the page shows "Invitation expired".
An invitation that would exceed the seat limit is rejected with "No seats available".
After onboarding, the teammate appears in the member list with the Member role.

tests.title: Owner invites a user by email
tests.objective: Verify that the owner can create a pending invitation for an email address.
tests.trigger: owner submits an invitation for an email
tests.expected: A pending invitation is created for the email.

tests.title: Invitation expires after seven days
tests.objective: Verify that an invitation becomes expired seven days after it was sent.
tests.expected: The invitation status is expired after 7 days.
tests.priority_reason: Stale invitations must not grant access.

tests.title: Valid invitation adds a member
tests.objective: Verify that accepting a valid invitation adds the user with the Member role.
tests.expected: The user joins the account with the Member role.

tests.title: Expired invitation cannot be accepted
tests.objective: Verify that an expired invitation is refused with the documented message.
tests.trigger: invited user accepts the expired invitation
tests.expected: The page shows "Invitation expired" and no membership is created.
tests.indivisible_contract: the refusal message and the absence of membership are one rejection outcome

tests.title: Invitation beyond the seat limit is rejected
tests.objective: Verify that an invitation exceeding the seat limit is rejected.
tests.expected: The invitation is rejected with "No seats available".

tests.title: Member cannot invite users
tests.objective: Verify that a Member is not allowed to invite users.
tests.expected: The invitation is refused as not permitted.

tests.title: Member cannot remove members
tests.objective: Verify that a Member is not allowed to remove another member.
tests.trigger: member requests removal of another member
tests.expected: The removal is refused as not permitted.

tests.title: New teammate is listed as Member
tests.objective: Verify that the onboarded teammate appears in the member list with the Member role.
tests.expected: The teammate appears in the member list with the Member role.

questions.question: What should happen when an already accepted invitation link is opened again?
questions.reason: The requirements define valid and expired invitations only.

questions.question: What must the owner see when the email provider fails to deliver an invitation?
questions.reason: No delivery failure policy is documented.

findings.statement: The implementation counts pending invitations against the seat limit, while the requirement limits active members only.

structure_reviews.reason: the second sentence only states the rejection message of the same seat limit invariant

dimensions.summary: Invalid invitation uses were reviewed for every invitation state.

candidates.description: Reopening an invitation that was already accepted.
candidates.question: Q-REUSE

dimensions.summary: Seat limit and expiry boundaries were reviewed.

candidates.description: Inviting the last free seat is still allowed.

test.title: Last free seat can still be invited
test.objective: Verify that an invitation that fills exactly the last seat is accepted.
test.expected: The invitation is created because the seat limit is not exceeded.

dimensions.summary: Owner and invited-user mistakes were reviewed against the invitation workflow.

candidates.description: A Member tries to invite someone as if they were the Owner.

intent.trigger: the member tries to send an invitation
intent.expected: the invitation is refused as not permitted

candidates.description: The invited user opens the same accepted link a second time.
candidates.question: Q-REUSE

patterns_reviewed.reason: the product has a single invite and accept action per invitation and no physical objects or background automation

dimensions.summary: Deliberate misuse of invitation links was reviewed; the only case depends on the reuse policy question.
Invitation states pending, accepted and expired were reviewed.

candidates.description: Pending invitation becomes a membership on acceptance.

intent.expected: the user becomes a member of the account with the Member role

dimensions.summary: The role by action matrix has two roles and two actions, already covered by the permission tests.
Simultaneous acceptance competing for the last seat was reviewed.

candidates.description: Two invited users accept at the same time when one seat is left.

test.title: Simultaneous acceptance never exceeds the seat limit
test.objective: Verify that concurrent acceptances cannot push active members beyond the seat limit.
test.state: account with one free seat and two pending invitations
test.trigger: both users accept at the same moment
test.expected: Active members stay within the seat limit after both acceptances.
test.priority_reason: Race would break the billing invariant.

dimensions.summary: Timing races reduce to the simultaneous acceptance candidate in CONCURRENCY.
Repeated acceptance depends on the reuse policy question; no other repeatable operation exists.
The email delivery dependency was reviewed.

candidates.description: Email provider fails while sending an invitation.

test.title: Invitation when email delivery fails
test.objective: Explore what the owner observes when the email provider rejects the invitation email.
test.expected: No invitation is reported as delivered while the provider is failing.

dimensions.summary: Recovery after an email failure depends on the undefined delivery policy (see the exploratory test).
Failure surfaces were reviewed against the documented architecture.

surfaces_reviewed.reason: the selected sources describe a synchronous web workflow with no cache, queue, devices or retries

dimensions.summary: Invitation link confidentiality is not described by the selected sources.
Owner-only invite and removal are covered by the permission tests.
Membership integrity is covered by the seat limit tests.
Interaction between expiry and seat limit was reviewed; no documented rule links them.
The onboarding use case was composed from atomic tests.
